excerpt.zh: 我们的合金赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
excerpt.en: Our alloys deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

texts.zh: 我们的合金赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
texts.en: Our alloys deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

texts.zh: [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]现在愈发关心我们帝国发生的合金短缺。如果不能尽快弥补上我们的支出，我们的工业部门将会收到广泛的影响。
texts.en: [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] is getting increasingly concerned about the alloy shortage befalling our empire. Failure to recoup our expenses will bring widespread disruptions to our industry sector.

texts.zh: 预算警告：当前合金支出已经超过了接下来数月的支出阈值。若不能解决短缺，将会给我们的工业区域造成广泛的扰乱。
texts.en: Budget warning: alloy expenditures surpassing expenditures for multiple subsequent months. Failure to resolve the shortage will bring widespread disruptions to our industry sector.

label.zh: 合并。循环。拆解[robots_planet.GetName]上的智能人。

label.en: Everything is going according to plan.

texts.zh: 由于无法解决合金短缺，我们被迫宣布破产并违约债务。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]正在起草新的紧缩经济计划以削减开支，避免这种情况再度发生。
texts.en: Having failed to resolve our alloys shortage, we have been forced to declare bankruptcy and default on our debts. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] is drafting a new austerity plan to cut expenses and preventing this situation from ever happening again.
